systems.name: Renderer
systems.summary: Owns the Vulkan context, the desktop and headset targets, the shared lighting / shade / soil state and the scene passes; runs the frame (prepare, updates, transfer -> compute -> graphics, parallel recording, present).

access.name: ModelManager
access.effect: Emplaced so that systems can load glTF models from their constructors and init.

access.name: ModelManager
access.effect: Erased before the device goes.

access.name: RenderSettings
access.effect: Emplaced, then the graphics level (applyGraphicsPreset) and the command line's lighting tier, probe rays and far plants written in.

access.name: Graphics
access.effect: current and presets: the level of resources/graphics.json to apply.

access.name: RunArgs
access.effect: lighting, probe_rays, far_plants; deterministic() picks the time of the frame.

access.name: FrameClock
access.effect: time of the frame in deterministic runs (captures, probes).

access.name: Executor
access.effect: The tf::Executor the desktop and headset command buffers are recorded on, in parallel.

access.name: ModelC
access.effect: reg.clear<ModelC>(): the meshes' GPU buffers go before the device.

side_effects: Creates the window, OpenXR session, Vulkan device and swapchain through Context.
Makes Lights, RayScene, ProbeVolume, PlantVolumes (with ray tracing), TreeShade, SoilMaps, ClassicRender, VRRender and the passes (SkyPass first, then the scene's renderer.passes).
GPU: per-frame fences and semaphores; one transfer, one compute and one graphics submission a frame; waits on the frame fence in prepare and on device idle in init and finish.
Threads: records both targets concurrently on the taskflow executor.
Log: 'Renderer : unknown pass <name>' (error).
Profiler zones: create lighting and targets, create pass / pipelines <name>, update <pass>, Update, Record, Submit.

systems.name: Context
systems.summary: The Vulkan and OpenXR context (VRContext, Windu, Instance, Device, GpuProfile, Transfer, Compute, Swapchain) and the view set layout; puts Context* in the registry context.

access.name: Context
access.effect: Context* to itself, for code that only has the registry (Terrain, ModelManager, loadGLTF, Input).

access.name: Settings
access.effect: vr_mode; window_width, window_height, fullscreen.

access.name: RunArgs
access.effect: window_hidden, ray_tracing, gpu_times.

side_effects: Creates the SDL window (SDL_Quit in its destructor), Vulkan instance, device, queues, VMA allocator, swapchain, OpenXR instance, session, reference space and eye swapchains.
Log: GPU name, ray tracing support, VR enabled or disabled with its reason, OpenXR and Vulkan validation messages.
The Context* context variable is never erased.

systems.name: ClassicRender
systems.summary: The desktop render target: swapchain render pass, per-frame command buffer and ViewUBO from the Camera, recording of the passes (through SunVisibility with ray tracing), present, captures, gpu_times.

access.name: RunArgs
access.effect: gpu_times: the timestamp query pool of the pass timings.

access.name: Input
access.effect: window_showing: nothing is acquired or drawn for a minimized window.

access.name: Camera
access.effect: Position, view and projection of the desktop ViewUBO.

access.name: RenderSettings
access.effect: tree_shade strength and the desktop lighting tier into the ViewUBO.

side_effects: GPU: command and descriptor pools, mapped uniform buffers, semaphores, query pool, capture buffer; records the desktop command buffer; acquires and presents swapchain images.
Log: gpu_times warnings and pass times every 300 frames and at each capture.
Profiler: CPU and GPU zones per pass (<pass> (desktop)), Sun rays / Composite (desktop).

systems.name: VRRender
systems.summary: The headset render target drawn alongside the desktop: OpenXR session events and frame loop, per-eye ViewUBO from the located views and the VRRig, recording per eye.

access.name: VRRig
access.effect: The stage's position and yaw in the world: world pose of each eye.

access.name: VRInput
access.effect: focused and session_running from the session state.

access.name: RenderSettings
access.effect: tree_shade strength and the VR lighting tier into the eyes' ViewUBO.

side_effects: Makes VRActions (which emplaces VRInput) even without a headset.
OpenXR: session begin / end / exit, xrWaitFrame (blocks), xrBeginFrame, xrEndFrame, eye swapchain images, view location.
GPU: per-frame and per-eye uniform buffers and descriptor sets, the headset command buffer.
Log: VR session started / stopped / lost, runtime shutting down.
Profiler: DY_FRAME_NAMED("Headset"), zones per pass and eye.

systems.name: VRActions
systems.summary: OpenXR actions of the controllers (pose, trigger, grip, thumbstick, primary, stick click) and the head pose, written into the VRInput context variable once a frame.

access.name: VRInput
access.effect: Head and hand poses, velocities, buttons and sticks; the previous trigger and primary give the rising edges, focused gates the hands.

side_effects: OpenXR: action set, actions, suggested bindings (Touch, Index, simple controller), action and view spaces, xrSyncActions and state queries every frame.
Log: failed OpenXR calls (xrCheckResult).

systems.name: ModelManager
systems.summary: Context variable that loads glTF files once (loadGLTF) or uploads meshes built in code, and hands out the entity holding their ModelC.

access.name: ModelC
access.effect: The mesh of a file or a key, on an entity it creates.

access.name: Context
access.effect: Context*: the transfer queue that uploads vertex, index and texture data.

side_effects: Entities: one per model file or key; a failed load leaves an empty entity behind.
Files: reads .gltf / .glb files and their buffers and images (tinygltf).
GPU: vertex, index and texture uploads through Transfer.
Log: glTF warnings, 'Loaded <path> : ...' (info), 'Could not load model <path> : ...' (error).

systems.name: TreeShade
systems.summary: Crown shadows of the plants (two soft discs each) on a 2048 m wrapping R8 map moved by the Sky's light; binding 1 of the view set; treeShadeView() fills ViewUBO::tree_shade.

access.name: Plant
access.effect: Which plants cast a shade and their species.

access.name: Transform
access.effect: Root position and scale of a plant.

access.name: Sky
access.effect: Direction of the light that casts the shadows.

access.name: VegetationLibrary
access.effect: Height and radius of the species.

access.name: RenderSettings
access.effect: tree_shade: the strength put in the ViewUBO.

side_effects: Signals: connects on_construct<Plant> and on_destroy<Plant> (disconnected in the destructor).

GPU: uploads a new 2048x2048 R8 image through Transfer whenever a plant came or went or the light moved (1 degree, 10 with ray tracing); old ones kept for the frames in flight; sets Context::tree_shade_view and tree_shade_sampler.

systems.name: SoilMaps
systems.summary: Bakes the soil map of each chunk (SoilField, 67x67 RGBA8) into a layer of a 2D array image when it gets its mesh or the parameters change; binding 2 of the view set; the SoilLayers context variable.

access.name: SoilLayers
access.effect: Layer of each chunk's soil map; enabled from RenderSettings::soil.

access.name: RenderSettings
access.effect: soil and soil_params (the key of the maps).

access.name: TerrainBuffers
access.effect: Number of chunk slots; absent until the Terrain system's init.

access.name: ChunkC
access.effect: Chunk coordinates of the map to bake.

access.name: ChunkGPU
access.effect: Mesh slot of the chunk.

access.name: ChunkReady
access.effect: Only chunks with a drawable mesh get a map.

side_effects: GPU: one RGBA8 2D array image of up to 2048 layers (about 37 MB), a layer upload (Transfer::updateImage) per chunk baked; sets Context::soil_view and soil_sampler.
CPU: SoilField::bake on the main thread, at most 16 re-bakes a frame after a parameter change.

systems.name: ChunkLayers
systems.summary: Allocates the layers of a 2D array image to chunk slots (soil maps, grass height maps): given when a chunk gets its mesh, retired NUM_FRAMES + 1 frames after it is gone or re-baked.

access.name: ChunkGPU
access.effect: Mesh slot a map record belongs to.

access.name: ChunkReady
access.effect: Only chunks with a drawable mesh get a layer.

side_effects: None of its own: the bake callback of its owner (SoilMaps, GrassPass) bakes and uploads.

components.name: Context
components.summary: The Vulkan / OpenXR context of the renderer, reachable from the registry as Context*.

fields.name: vr
fields.desc: OpenXR instance, session, reference space, eye swapchains; enabled() false without a headset

fields.name: win
fields.desc: SDL2 window and its Vulkan surface

fields.name: instance
fields.desc: Vulkan instance (1.2 where available, else 1.1)

fields.name: device
fields.desc: physical and logical device, queues (graphics, compute, transfer, indices g_i, c_i, t_i), VMA allocator, ray (RayContext)

fields.name: gpu_profile
fields.desc: Tracy Vulkan context, zones on the GPU with profile=true

fields.name: transfer
fields.desc: staging uploads, flushed once a frame

fields.name: compute
fields.desc: ring of compute command buffers recorded during the tick

fields.name: swap
fields.desc: desktop swapchain: format, extent, images, current image, readable

fields.name: view_layout
fields.desc: layout of set 0 of every scene pipeline (bindings 0 to 3, 4 to 12 with ray tracing)

fields.name: tree_shade_view
fields.desc: current map of TreeShade (binding 1)

fields.name: tree_shade_sampler
fields.desc: linear, repeat

fields.name: soil_view
fields.desc: 2D array of the soil maps (SoilMaps, binding 2)

fields.name: soil_sampler
fields.desc: linear, clamp to edge

fields.name: lights_buffers
fields.desc: LightsUBO of each frame (Lights, binding 3)

fields.name: tlas
fields.desc: top level structure of the frame (RayScene, binding 4)

fields.name: ray_geometries
fields.desc: geometry table of RayScene (binding 5)

fields.name: ray_textures
fields.desc: textures the rays alpha test against (RayMeshes, binding 6, up to 512)

fields.name: probe_index_view
fields.desc: table of the probe brick of each chunk (ProbeVolume, binding 7)

fields.name: probe_index_sampler
fields.desc: sampler of the probe index

fields.name: probe_light
fields.desc: three light textures per probe page (binding 8, up to 16 pages)

fields.name: probe_direct
fields.desc: sun and sky texture per probe page (binding 9)

fields.name: plant_volumes
fields.desc: density, colour and normal volumes of the species (PlantVolumes, bindings 10 to 12, up to 128)

fields.name: frame_index
fields.desc: frame in flight being prepared, 0 .. NUM_FRAMES - 1 (Renderer::prepare)

components.notes: Held in the registry context as a raw pointer (reg.ctx().get<Context*>()), emplaced by the Context constructor (a member of Renderer, made before any system) and never erased: it dangles after the renderer is destroyed. Only in the viewer (dynamical).

components.name: ModelManager
components.summary: Cache of glTF models and code-built meshes: path or key to the entity holding its ModelC.

fields.name: reg
fields.desc: the registry the model entities are made in (private)

fields.name: models
fields.desc: path or key to the entity holding its ModelC (private)

components.notes: Emplaced by the Renderer's constructor, erased by Renderer::finish after the ModelC storage is cleared. Methods: load(path), get(path), add(key, MeshData). Main thread only.

components.name: ModelC
components.summary: GPU mesh of a loaded glTF file (node transforms baked in) or of a code-built mesh, on its own entity; instances point at it with ModelRenderable.

fields.name: vertices
fields.desc: ModelVertex buffer (position, normal, uv), with ray build usage when ray tracing is on

fields.name: indices
fields.desc: uint32 index buffer

fields.name: parts
fields.desc: first_index, index_count and material of each primitive

fields.name: materials
fields.desc: base_color (vec4), image (shared_ptr<VmaImage>, null: white), set (set 1 of the model pipeline, filled by ModelPass); the last one is the default material

fields.name: min
fields.desc: lower corner of the bounds, model space

fields.name: max
fields.desc: upper corner of the bounds, model space

fields.name: ray_mesh
fields.desc: index in RayMeshes given by ModelPass with ray tracing, -1 otherwise

components.notes: Created by ModelManager::load / add on an entity of its own, one per file or key, never per instance. Renderer::finish clears the storage (GPU buffers must go before the device). Read by ModelPass and RayScene.

components.name: ChunkGPU
components.summary: The GPU mesh slot of a chunk: its vertex buffer and indirect draw command in TerrainBuffers.

fields.name: slot
fields.desc: index of the slot (0 .. 2047): TerrainBuffers::vertices[slot], indirect command at slot x indirect_stride

components.notes: Emplaced or replaced by the Terrain system when it records the marching cubes of the chunk (the previous slot freed NUM_FRAMES + 1 frames later); cleared in its destructor. Read by the terrain and grass passes, RayScene and ChunkLayers.

components.name: ChunkReady
components.summary: The chunk's mesh was computed in a submitted compute batch and can be drawn.
components.notes: Emplaced by the Terrain system with ChunkGPU (the graphics submission of the frame waits on its compute), cleared in its destructor; storage created in its init so the passes can view it from worker threads. Read by the terrain and grass passes, RayScene, ChunkLayers and the debug menu.

components.name: ChunkTriangles
components.summary: Triangle count of the chunk's mesh, read back from the GPU a few frames after it was built (ray tracing only).

fields.name: count
fields.desc: triangles of the mesh (vertexCount / 3 of its indirect command)

fields.name: slot
fields.desc: slot of the mesh that was counted

components.notes: Written by the Terrain system NUM_FRAMES frames after the meshing frame, only with ray tracing and only if the chunk still has that slot; removed when the chunk is meshed again. Read by RayScene to build the chunk's acceleration structure.

components.name: TerrainBuffers
components.summary: The GPU buffers of the terrain meshes, read by the terrain and grass passes, RayScene and SoilMaps.

fields.name: indirect
fields.desc: one vk::DrawIndirectCommand per slot (vertex count written by marchingcubes.comp.glsl)

fields.name: indirect_stride
fields.desc: bytes between two commands (aligned to minStorageBufferOffsetAlignment, at least 16)

fields.name: vertices
fields.desc: vertex buffer (TerrainVertex, 2^15 triangles) of each slot allocated so far

components.notes: Emplaced by the Terrain system's init, vertices grown as slots are allocated, erased in its destructor. Its absence means no terrain (SoilMaps and the passes do nothing).

components.name: SoilLayers
components.summary: Where the passes find the layer of the soil map of a chunk while they record.

fields.name: chunks
fields.desc: layer of each chunk slot's map in the soil 2D array

fields.name: enabled
fields.desc: RenderSettings::soil; false: layer() returns -1

components.notes: Emplaced by SoilMaps' constructor (always, with the renderer), updated by SoilMaps::update on the main thread, erased in its destructor. layer(slot, chunk) is read by the terrain and grass passes while they record.
